featured.title: ForgeCapita
featured.subtitle: Milestone based crowdfunding platform
featured.description: Investors fund SaaS startups through milestone based escrow, and the startup's revenue flows back to them automatically through smart contracts. Each project gets its own token, escrow, staking vault and revenue router, deployed by a factory contract. Investors stake tokens to vote on each milestone before funds are released, and incoming revenue is split 75% to stakers, 24% to the founder and 1% to the platform. Currently live on the Arbitrum Sepolia and BSC testnets.
highlights: Solidity contracts for escrow, voting, dividends and a P2P token exchange, tested with Hardhat
Node.js + TypeScript API with wallet sign-in and a gasless transaction relayer
Multi-chain Ponder indexer storing on-chain events in PostgreSQL, served over GraphQL
Next.js frontend with separate areas for investors, founders and staff

featured.title: Zypher
featured.subtitle: CI/CD pipeline security assistant
featured.description: A full stack web app that runs static analysis on CI/CD configuration files to catch vulnerabilities and enforce best practices. It uses a rule based scan engine with dynamically loaded rules, and reports each finding with a severity, the exact code location and a suggested fix.
highlights: Took part in sprint planning and built parts of the core scanning logic and scan engine
Built REST endpoints for scan operations and tested them with Swagger UI
Deployed and managed the Next.js app and FastAPI backend on Render

featured.title: SkillSwap
featured.subtitle: Skill exchange platform
featured.description: A web app where people list the skills they can teach and the skills they want to learn, then get matched with others whose skills complement theirs. The backend is a Spring Boot REST API secured with Spring Security and JWT, with database migrations managed by Flyway.
highlights: Spring Boot REST API with Spring Security and JWT authentication
Skill matching between teachers and learners
Versioned schema migrations with Flyway on PostgreSQL

other.title: Multimodal RAG Tourism System
other.description: A Sri Lanka tourism assistant that answers both text and image queries. It combines SQL lookups in PostgreSQL (fees, hours, locations) with semantic text search and CLIP image search over Qdrant, then uses Gemini to extract intent and write the final answer, with memory for multi-turn chats.

other.title: GymVerse
other.description: A gym management platform connecting members, trainers and the owner. Includes workout and meal plans, QR based attendance, class booking and an owner analytics dashboard, built on a custom JavaScript router that gives it single page app behaviour.

other.title: VolunteerLink
other.description: A platform that connects volunteers with organizations looking for skilled people. Covers profiles, opportunity listings, applications and status tracking.
